fonts.display: 'Gelica', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Articulat CF', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, deepest foreground — the absolute ink for body copy and legal/footer type

palette.name: Zinc Ink
palette.role: Headlines, nav text, icons, filled button background — the universal interactive ink

palette.name: Slate 700
palette.role: Body text emphasis, input fill backgrounds for dark/inverted inputs

palette.name: Slate 600
palette.role: Secondary body text, input borders, subtle button borders

palette.name: Slate 500
palette.role: Muted helper text, link text, icon details

palette.name: Zinc 500
palette.role: Icon strokes (the dominant icon color), secondary UI lines

palette.name: Zinc 300
palette.role: Card borders when slightly more definition is needed than the default hairline

palette.name: Zinc 200
palette.role: Universal hairline border — by far the most-used color in the system at 360+ border applications

palette.name: Zinc 100
palette.role: Card surfaces, hero background tint, subtle section backgrounds

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page-tinted background variant, near-white surfaces for cards that need separation from pure white

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Primary canvas and card surface — the page sits on white

palette.name: Footer Green
palette.role: Footer band background — the only chromatic UI color, a friendly grass green that punctuates the monochrome page
